title: Transportation Infrastructure Plans to Support Build-up of Tuas Mega Port and Increased Business Activities in Tuas
what_it_is: Transportation Infrastructure Plans to Support Build-up of Tuas Mega Port and Increased Business Activities in Tuas

sections.label: Tuas transport provisions expansion
sections.summary: LTA and agencies are expanding transport provisions in Tuas to support expected travel demand, including MRT stations, bus services, a viaduct and the Jurong Region Line.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) and agencies have been monitoring the pace of developments in the Tuas area, including the plan for the build-up of operations at Tuas Port up till the 2040s when it will become fully operational.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: To support the expected increase in travel demand to the area, LTA has been progressively expanding transport provisions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In 2017, LTA completed the Tuas West Extension by adding four Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) stations to the East-West Line.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA also introduced two new public bus services 247 and 248 to enhance transport connectivity in the Tuas and Tuas South region.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Tuas Road Viaduct Phase 1, which improves accessibility to Tuas South and Tuas Port, has also been completed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The completion of the Jurong Region Line by the second half of this decade will also significantly improve connectivity in the Western region and benefit workers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA and the Maritime Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) have also worked with PSA to expand the coverage of their employee shuttle services to complement the public bus network.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Agencies will continue to monitor the travel demand, review the adequacy of transport provisions, and engage key stakeholders of the area, such as PSA and the unions.
